subheader: What large buyers get, and an invitation to talk rather than a checkout
lead: Security review, single sign-on, a named contact, custom terms, an invoice on account — the things that are decided in a meeting rather than chosen from a list.
note: The note says what the conversation costs and how long an offer stands. Both answers are usually reassuring, and neither is usually given.

capabilities.title: The price slot still gets display size
capabilities.text: A box with nothing at its price line reads as missing something rather than as priced differently.

capabilities.title: Capabilities are an icon-led grid
capabilities.text: Two to four columns, each cell a title and one sentence.

capabilities.title: The image is optional
capabilities.text: The band works as copy and capabilities alone.

capabilities.title: Both actions live under the price
capabilities.text: One to start the conversation, one to take a document away and read it first.
